subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and trust portal access
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medilabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and trust portal access

Hey Lena — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side after the product demo: 

- Ask: Can you share the SOC 2 Type II report (or a redacted extract) and a signed bridge letter for the current reporting period? Procurement indicated they need evidence for the security review.
- Portal: We'd prefer to exchange artifacts via your trust portal. If that’s not possible this week, please confirm an SFTP fallback and the preferred encryption (we support AES-256).
- Timeline: Would a delivery window of July 5–7 work for Medilabs (report + bridge letter + any DSQ responses)?
- Contacts: looping Monica (security) and Ben (portal onboarding) to help with artifact upload and access.

If there are any specific redaction rules or a minimum artifact list you need from us for reciprocity, send them over and we’ll prep.

Thanks — I’ll follow up Thursday if I don’t hear back.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medilabs.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: medilabs_security@medilabs.com, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@procure.medilabs.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and trust portal access

Thanks Vivek — good demo. Quick answers: 

- Timeline: Procurement is aiming to complete our vendor review by July 14; we’d need the SOC2 package before July 12 to meet internal sign-offs. July 5–7 works for an initial handoff.
- Artifacts we typically need: full SOC 2 Type II report OR a redacted PDF, signed bridge letter (templated), the SOC control matrix (high level), and a contact for any clarification.
- Portal vs SFTP: We prefer using our trust portal. If there’s a delay, SFTP is acceptable. For SFTP please confirm we can use SSH key auth; all files should be encrypted at rest (AES-256).
- Redactions: We allow redaction of customer names and non-control-specific internal IP; procurement will advise if anything else is required.

I’ve added medilabs_security for logistics. Tom — FYI on dates.

Lena
Security & Compliance Lead
MediLabs
